chunks: And it is narrated regarding a woman who cut off the breast of her female slave:
That she is free, and her mistress has no authority over her.

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman; here, the mistress involved in the case
key_terms.ثَدْيَ: the breast; the body part mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.قَطَعَتْ: cut off; indicating severe physical mutilation
key_terms.لِمَوْلَاتِهَا: for her mistress; the owner who loses authority

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a mistress mutilates her female slave?
ai.summary: This report conveys a legal ruling concerning severe abuse by a mistress against her female slave. It states that when such grave bodily harm is inflicted, the female slave is set free and the mistress loses authority over her.
